Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the state property tax levy and protecting education funding.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating the state property tax levy andprotecting education funding; creating new sections; and repealing RCW84.52.065, 84.52.067, 84.52.068, and 84.48.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that owners of realproperty, including homeowners, throughout Washington state haveexperienced rapid increases in property taxes and are in need ofmeaningful relief. The legislature intends by this act to reduce theproperty tax burden by eliminating the state property tax levy, whileproviding that education funding levels are not affected or supplantedas a result of repealing the state property tax levy.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 84.52.065 (State levy for support of common schools) and1991 sp.s. c 31 s 16, 1979 ex.s. c 218 s 1, 1973 1st ex.s. c 195 s 106,1971 ex.s. c 299 s 25, 1969 ex.s. c 216 s 2, & 1967 ex.s. c 133 s 1; RCW 84.52.067 (State levy for support of common schoolsDisposition of funds) and 2001 c 3 s 7 & 1967 ex.s. c 133 s 2; p. 1 HB 3353 RCW 84.52.068 (State levyDistribution to school districts)and 2005 c 514 s 1104, 2003 1st sp.s. c 19 s 1, & 2001 c 3 s 5; and RCW 84.48.080 (Equalization of assessmentsTaxes for statepurposesProcedureLevy and apportionmentHypothetical levy forestablishing consolidated levyRulesRecord) and 2001 c 185 s 12,1997 c 3 s 112, 1995 2nd sp.s. c 13 s 3, 1994 c 301 s 43, 1990 c 283 s1, 1988 c 222 s 24, 1982 1st ex.s. c 28 s 1, 1979 ex.s. c 86 s 3, 19731st ex.s. c 195 s 99, 1971 ex.s. c 288 s 9, & 1961 c 15 s 84.48.080.
The repeal of the state property tax levy insection 2 of this act does not affect or supplant education fundinglevels.
This act applies to taxes levied forcollection in 2009 and thereafter.

If any repealers in this act, or anysections enacted or affected by this act, are enacted in a 2008legislative session that do not take cognizance of this act, the codereviser must prepare a bill for introduction in the 2009 or 2010legislative session that incorporates any such amendments into thereorganization adopted by this act and corrects any references madeobsolete as a result of enacting this act.
